2048

Use arrow keys or swipe to slide the tiles.

How to play

Slide the whole board. Matching numbers combine into one bigger tile. Reach 2048 to win!

  • ← ↑ ↓ → to slide
  • WASD works too

Quick tip

Keep your biggest tile in a corner and build around it.

No timer. Take your time, then undo your last move if you need to.
